brief: Admits or refuses requests per key with one engine token bucket each, so short bursts pass and the sustained rate stays capped.
detail: Give each key a rate and a burst with SetLimit, then ask Allow before serving a request. A key with no limit is unlimited. Block and BlockFor shut a key out whatever its bucket holds; refusals are noted in the refusal ledger. Where stzRetryBudget caps the retries of one workload, this class caps the request rate of many independent keys. Destroy frees the engine buckets.
